sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们一起出演过《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专门为你带来了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们将剖析一集《办公室》，并分享只有亲历者才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: This is Season 7, Episode 18, Todd Packer.
sentences.zh: 这是第七季第18集，《托德·帕克》。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty cool if your character gets its own episode.

sentences.en: Like, I would have loved an episode called Angela Martin.
sentences.zh: 比如，我一定会很喜欢一集叫《安吉拉·马丁》的剧。

sentences.en: It was written by Amelie Gillette, directed by Randall Einhorn.
sentences.zh: 本集由阿梅莉·吉莱特编剧，兰德尔·艾因霍恩执导。

sentences.en: The gang is upset when traveling salesman Todd Packer is offered a permanent sales position in the office.
sentences.zh: 当四处奔波的推销员托德·帕克获得办公室的一个长期推销职位时，大家都很不高兴。

sentences.en: It causes such contempt that Dwight and Jim joined forces to oust him.
sentences.zh: 这引发了如此强烈的反感，以至于德怀特和吉姆联手将他赶走。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Andy really, really wants a new computer.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，安迪非常、非常想要一台新电脑。

sentences.en: He is very envious that Pam bought a new one for the reception desk.
sentences.zh: 因为帕姆给前台买了一台新的，他对此羡慕嫉妒恨。

sentences.en: Before we jump into fast facts, I just have to share something with everyone.
sentences.zh: 在我们进入快速问答环节之前，我必须和大家分享一件事。

sentences.en: Jenna was the first person here today at Earwolf, and apparently she found the thermostat.

sentences.en: Like, my glass has a little bit of, like, a frosty side.

sentences.en: I feel like when you go to a restaurant and they're like, don't worry, we have a heat lamp on the patio.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你去一家餐馆，他们说，别担心，我们在露台上有个加热灯。

sentences.en: And then they sit you right under it, and you're like, ugh.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把你安排在正下方，你会想，呃。
我们要把它调小一点吗？

sentences.en: I can't believe I'm saying that.

sentences.en: It feels like when you go into, like, a movie and it's so warm, you go, whoa, I'll be sleeping through this.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像你走进一家电影院，里面太暖和了，你会觉得，哇，我这觉是睡定了。

sentences.en: I was so cold when I got here.
This is going to be sleepy Todd Packer.

sentences.en: And when Amelie joined The Office, the A.V.

sentences.zh: 我们电视俱乐部的任何常客都会告诉你，他们绝没有打算给这部剧打更高分来拍她的马屁，顺便谋求一个自己的电视剧编剧工作。

他基本上很喜欢这一集。

sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，托德·帕克就像是你被邀请去某人家非常漂亮的房子里。

sentences.en: They've drawn you a nice bath, and you get in that bathtub, and you splash out all the

sentences.en: You dirty all their towels and walk out naked where they're having a children's party in

sentences.zh: 所以安吉拉，我觉得我们以前没聊过的一点是，其实曾有一位演员被选中

sentences.en: And they recast him with Dave Koechner.

sentences.en: And now he's got a whole episode.
sentences.zh: 现在他有一整集的戏了。

sentences.en: Now he has a whole episode.

sentences.zh: 瓶装剧是好莱坞电视界的术语，指的是基本上只在既定的

sentences.en: It has very minimal stunts, minimal special effects, minimal visual effects.
sentences.zh: 它的特技极少，特效极少，视觉特效也极少。

sentences.en: And he had to allocate it for the whole year for each episode.

sentences.en: divide the budget into all the different categories that they had to pay for for a particular
sentences.zh: 把预算划分到特定一集所需支付的

sentences.en: No, please don't make me do that.

sentences.zh: 为了平衡收支，编剧们不得不安排一定数量的室内剧
